action: General advice: buy only through official retailer sites, avoid links in unsolicited messages, and use unique passwords with multifactor authentication.
date_note: The relaying article gives only its own publication day; Check Point Research's own page was not read.
exec: A trade article citing Check Point Research says attacks on consumer goods and services organisations rose 28% in September and October 2026.
plain: DARetail, citing Check Point Research, says attacks on consumer goods and services organisations rose 28% in September and October 2026, and reports new shopping-themed domains.

sources.name: DARetail (Distribución Actualidad): Los ciberataques al comercio minorista aumentan un 28% antes del Black Friday

summary: DARetail, citing Check Point Research data, reports that cyberattacks on the consumer goods and services sector rose 28% in September and October 2026, with global attacks up 22%. It also reports new domains tied to shopping events or known brands, some flagged as potentially dangerous. Check Point's own report was not read.
title: Check Point Research data, via DARetail: attacks on consumer goods and services up 28% before Black Friday

validation.note: Single publisher (DARetail) relaying Check Point Research; Check Point's own page was not found or read.

que sitúa en el 22% el crecimiento global de los ciberataques.
